question_text: A 40-year-old female comes in with several months of unintentional weight loss, epigastric pain, and a sensation of abdominal pressure. She has diabetes well-controlled on metformin but no other prior medical history. She has not previously had any surgeries. On physical exam, her doctor notices brown velvety areas of pigmentation on her neck. Her doctor also notices an enlarged, left supraclavicular node. Endoscopic findings show a stomach wall that appears to be grossly thickened. Which of the following findings would most likely be seen on biopsy?
